jobs.title: International Financial Controller
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As the International Financial Controller, you will be the senior-most member of the Sitetracker International Finance team that is responsible for end-to-end ownership of accounting operations, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, and financial reporting across seven key international entities (UK, Spain, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, Australia, and India).

Reporting directly to the CFO, you won't just oversee timelines and responsibilities that are tethered to the current way of doing things—you will serve as a strategic leader redefining current processes that require modernization of manual repeatable workflows into streamlined and automated workflows that will subsequently allow the team to spend more time on providing insights to and driving tangible value for the business including optimizing foreign currency, transfer pricing, A/P management, and financial reporting, as well as scaling our global presence.

This is a unique career-defining opportunity with freedom to re-build and modernize our international financial controllership organization and partner with the broader US Finance team to create a global foundation focused on providing strategic insights and driving real enterprise value and not just closing the books for a globally scaling organization.

What You'll Do

You will lead the International Finance team responsible for end-to-end close and consolidation cycle across all seven international legal entities, driving a clean, sub-10-day accounting close that is free of material weaknesses or recurring gaps. Partnering closely with the CFO and US Controller, you will serve as a credible, trusted voice to local board members, external audit committees, and executive stakeholders while bridging international accounting standards with US GAAP consolidation.

Beyond monthly reporting, you will take complete ownership of regional compliance, steering our full slate of statutory audits, local tax filings (VAT/GST, Corporate Income Tax), payroll and transfer pricing arrangements across multiple jurisdictions. Ownership is defined as not simply taking over existing processes - the expectation is a full evaluation and subsequent modernization of our global accounting processes, with a key initial initiative focused on overhauling and re-tooling our current monthly close and Accounts Payable workflows into an automated, scalable procure-to-pay tech stack.

As an empowering people leader, you will directly manage and mentor a distributed team of 2 current direct reports in London and India, re-invigorating currently manual journal entry and reconciliation workflows while instilling a culture of continuous operational improvement. As Sitetracker continues to expand globally, you will act as the finance lead standing up new international legal entities, establishing local banking relationships, and embedding robust internal control environments from day one. You will be comfortable turning ambiguous situations, like a new market or an unclear local requirement, into a workable plan without waiting to be told exactly what to do.

You'll bring a documentation-first mindset to everything you own. That means turning recurring processes (close, payroll etc.) into clear, concise workflows and reporting that your team can execute without friction, and that leadership can review and sign off on quickly. With seven entities and multiple regulatory and payroll calendars running at once, exceptional organization isn't a nice-to-have. It's how you keep nothing from falling through the cracks.

The Skills You'll Have

Multi-entity, multi-currency accounting & statutory compliance & Expansion Support

- Hold a recognized professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).

- Possess proven experience owning the month-end and quarter-end close process for 3+ legal entities across 2+ foreign currencies, managing complex US GAAP to IFRS/local GAAP reconciliations.

- Show experience designing or significantly improving consolidation frameworks, including foreign currency translation methodologies and elimination logic.

- Bring a proven capability to accelerate multi-entity close calendars while maintaining meticulous accuracy and regulatory compliance.

- Demonstrate a track record of supporting new international entity registrations, standing up local banking, statutory setups, and foundational internal controls.

Multi-jurisdiction audit, tax, & internal controls management

- Demonstrate hands-on experience managing concurrent statutory audits and tax filings (VAT/GST, corporate income tax) across multiple jurisdictions, leading PBC list management and auditor relationships.

- Possess expertise designing, implementing, and maintaining robust internal control environments, approval matrices, and reconciliation standards across international subsidiaries.

- Show proven capability to align local statutory regulations with global financial policies and reporting schedules.

- Bring direct experience evaluating, executing, and managing cross-border transfer pricing arrangements and intercompany service agreements.

- Demonstrate a proactive ability to identify, mitigate, and resolve potential cross-border regulatory or compliance risks before they impact the business.

Payroll oversight, AP, vendor payment management & Tooling

- Possess hands-on experience overseeing multi-country payroll processes and AP/vendor payment workflows, ensuring absolute accuracy and swift resolution of discrepancies.

- Demonstrate high proficiency operating within NetSuite ERP for close and consolidation activities, backed by advanced Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling skills.

- Bring practical working experience leveraging close-management and financial automation tools (such as FloQast, Bill.com, or Concur) to maintain operational velocity.

- Show proven success leading multi-entity AP change management, including transitioning manual procure-to-pay processes into modern, automated AP platforms.

- Demonstrate a track record of evaluating and then implementing technology automation to significantly reduce accounting close cycles down to a sub-10-day schedule.

Foreign currency, intercompany & banking/cash management

- Demonstrate expertise in accounting for foreign currency transactions, FX revaluations/remeasurements, and complex intercompany eliminations.

- Possess direct experience managing intercompany journal entries and maintaining clean intercompany balance ledger reconciliations across multiple entities.

- Show experience coordinating international banking setup, payment approvals, and cash positioning across distributed multi-entity bank accounts.

- Bring experience advising on or structuring intercompany agreements and transfer pricing frameworks alongside legal and tax advisors.

- Demonstrate a history of strategically partnering with executive leadership to optimize global cash operations and manage multi-currency liquidity risks.

Organization, documentation & cross-border leadership

- Exceptionally well-organized, with a track record of calmly managing multiple regulatory, audit and payroll calendars at once without anything slipping.

- Documents repeatable workflows into concise playbooks and reporting built for easy review: clear status, exceptions surfaced, and supporting detail one click away.

- Builds well-formatted reports and datasets for ad hoc analysis that are detailed but concise, and that speed up decisions rather than create more work.

- Communicates proactively across time zones, using async updates, standing cadences and shared trackers to keep distributed finance, HR and legal partners aligned.

- Has directly managed and developed team members across geographies, and genuinely enjoys growing people.
Within 90 Days, You'll:
- Take full operational ownership of the monthly close and consolidation cycle across all seven international entities, establishing clear close calendars and aligning reporting schedules with the US Controller.

- Conduct a comprehensive assessment of current international AP, payroll, JE and reconciliation workflows, identifying immediate manual friction points and quick-win process enhancements.

- Build a single, consolidated view of the international close, statutory audit, tax filing and payroll calendars across all entities, with documented owners, deadlines and status reporting that makes review by the CFO and US Controller fast and simple.

- Establish strong working relationships with your direct reports in London and India, setting up structured mentoring cadences and reviewing local statutory audit schedules.
Within 180 Days, You'll:
- Collaborate with the US Controller to select, design, and deploy an upgraded, automated global Accounts Payable tool, successfully eliminating manual Excel-based international AP processes.

- Successfully navigate the full slate of annual international statutory audits (where required) and tax filings across all active entities with zero missed deadlines or preventable findings.

- Optimize foreign exchange translation methodologies and intercompany reconciliation workflows to accelerate the regional close timeline toward a sub-10-day target.
Within 365 Days, You'll:
- Establish a highly automated, best-in-class international controlling function that seamlessly scales as Sitetracker expands into new global territories.

- Benchmark and refine multi-jurisdiction transfer pricing models and cross-border tax arrangements, ensuring full tax optimization and robust regulatory compliance.

- Develop and empower your direct reports into elevated roles, having built a resilient, scalable regional finance structure ready to absorb broader global controllership responsibilities.

jobs.title: Associate Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Associate Customer Success Manager to join our growing Customer Success team in India. As an Associate CSM, you will work with customers at all stages of the customer journey from implementation through go-live as they deploy and adopt the Sitetracker platform.
As the main point of contact, you will define and demonstrate Sitetracker's value to our customers by identifying business objectives and aligning Sitetracker capabilities with your customer's goals. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will own user adoption and customer advocacy to ensure the retention and growth of our customers.
What You'll Do
You will be the primary advocate and trusted advisor for your customers. You will establish a regular interaction cadence, create action plans to deliver against KPIs, and ensure you have referenceable customers to support global sales efforts. Beyond day-to-day interactions, you will continually develop strategic account plans to support product expansion and engage directly with Sitetracker Product & Engineering to communicate customer requests regarding product roadmaps and customizations.
The Skills You'll Have
Core Customer Success Manager Skills
Create and execute comprehensive success plans tailored to individual customer needs.
Demonstrate a history of passion and enthusiasm for customer success and a commitment to personal development.
Excellent written communication skills
Apply experience working with mid-tier customers to manage books of business effectively, and drive renewals
Improving Customer Experience & Stakeholder Management
Foster high-level relationships with senior stakeholders and project sponsors within a customer environment.
Create and deliver communication plans that keep customers informed and engaged.
Understand customer use cases and Sitetracker adoption at a high level, becoming a trusted advisor.
Demonstrating Business Value Realisation & Contract Value
Identify, deliver, and masterfully articulate the Sitetracker solution's value and return on investment to customers.
Partner with customer leadership to identify and measure new KPIs, focusing heavily on business outcomes and value realization.
Identify additional revenue-generating opportunities by aligning customer goals with Sitetracker functionality and roadmaps.
Technical Aptitude
Develop a strong technical understanding of deployed solutions and Sitetracker platform capabilities.
Complete internal certifications to accelerate product knowledge and independent troubleshooting capability.
Contribute to internal process improvements and engage with Engineering to discuss enhanced product functionality.

Within 90 Days, You'll
- Work with cross-functional teams to learn the Sitetracker product and capabilities.

- Undertake internal certification to accelerate your product knowledge and onboarding.

- Work closely with customer success, and other teams, to establish yourself internally.

- Meet and familiarize yourself with customers within your book of business.

- Establish and become the main point of contact for your customers.

- Establish cadence and regular interaction with your customer base.

- Understand customer’s use cases and ST adoption at a high level
Within 180 Days, You'll
- Be a trusted advisor and advocate for your customers.

- Partner with your customer’s leadership to develop a blueprint for success.

- Understand the customer’s business goals and objectives.

- Identify and measure potential new KPIs for your customers.

- Align your customer goals with Sitetracker functionality and roadmap.

- Create an action plan to deliver against goals, KPIs, and functionality.

- Identify additional revenue-generating opportunities.

- Masterfully articulate the Sitetracker value proposition.

- Ensure you have referenceable customers to support a wider global sales effort.

- Contribute to opportunities for process improvement and continue to develop your own Sitetracker product knowledge.
Within 365 Days, You'll
- Continuously act as a trusted advisor to the customer, and develop high-level relationships with stakeholders and project sponsors.

- Continuously develop  strategic account plans for your customers to support product expansion and ensure customer retention.

- Engage with Sitetracker Product & Engineering to support and communicate customer requests around product roadmaps, customizations, or enhanced product functionality.

- Establish yourself as an integral part of the customer success team.

- Have a great time with in an exciting, fast paced environment!

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships - AMER
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
This is a career-defining opportunity to play a leading role in growth of the Americas region for Sitetracker through Partners. You’ll build and activate high-value, strategic alliances with SIs, Consultancies, and ISVs, influencing major players within the critical infrastructure ecosystem. This is a challenging, growth-oriented opportunity within a high-performing team, where your commercial acumen and ability to move with speed and rigour will directly shape our market expansion. You will drive immediate revenue growth by expertly activating our established Global SI alliances in the region and building an exceptional network of Regional SIs.
Focus markets: US, Canada, LATAM
What You'll Do
Reporting directly to the VP Global Partnerships, you will be responsible for driving revenue through and with Partners in the AMER region. You will be instrumental in driving our go-to-market efforts in concert with the regional sales leaders. You will provide GTM enablement to our priority partners, build relationships, drive joint business plans, spearhead co-selling initiatives, and relentlessly drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue to achieve ambitious ARR targets.
The Skills You'll Have
Commercial Execution (Sourced & Influenced)
Track record of generating partner sourced opportunities through strategic partner initiatives.
Experience of identifying how and when to bring the right partners into direct sales cycles to add value.
Consistently exceed personal revenue targets, demonstrating a strong commercial drive.
Demonstrate a hands-on approach to leading sales cycles together with Partners and AEs, including shaping  joint value propositions, preparing sales collateral, and drafting joint delivery models.
Market Activation
Articulate a compelling value proposition for SIs, Consultancies and ISVs to partner with Sitetracker
Provide evidence of successfully mapping internal account lists with partner accounts to identify concrete opportunities for collaboration.
Understand the internal dynamics and structure of professional service organisations and identify the key profiles to sponsor and drive partnerships
Share success stories of converting nascent or unproductive partnerships into highly productive ones
Point to multiple successful account mapping exercises that directly translated into leads and opportunities, bringing account teams together for a joint customer approach with partners similar to Sitetracker's.
Leadership & territory management
Ability to demonstrate a structured, strategic approach to regional prioritization, maximizing ROI across diverse markets.
Experience implementing programmatic governance (e.g., QBRs, joint business plans) to advance partners from registered to preferred tiers.
Successfully navigated and resolved complex partner issues or escalations, protecting high-value relationships.
Demonstrated ability to maintain strong, productive relationships with large SI partners even during challenging situations.
Ecosystem Fluency
Extensive experience within relevant industries such as Telco, Energy, Utilities, or Critical Infrastructure.
An existing understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem and experience working at/with  Salesforce SI or ISV partners. 
Knowledge of the competitive landscape for asset lifecycle management solutions in AMER

Within 90 Days, You'll
- Integrate swiftly into the Partners organisation, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the current partner network and ongoing initiatives.

- Conduct 1:1s with all AMER AEs and SEs to identify 'at-risk' or 'stalled' deals where a partner can provide an immediate 'win' or entry point

- Have command of the Sitetracker message and be able to articulate our story and value proposition to partners and prospects

- Establish joint business plans with at least two priority Global SIs, translating global alliances into actionable regional strategies.

- Initiate outreach and secure discovery meetings with 5-7 key regional SI, boutique, or ISV partners from your existing network.

- Contribute to pipeline development by identifying and registering your first partner-sourced opportunities.
Within 180 Days, You'll
- Drive measurable ARR growth by closing your first partner-sourced deal, demonstrating commercial execution.

- Expand partnership reach by onboarding and initiating co-selling activities with at least three new regional partners.

- Implement a structured regional strategy, clearly prioritizing sub-regions and allocating investment to maximize high-upside markets.
Within 365 Days, You'll
- Achieve your annual ARR targets by consistently driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, establishing a strong regional foundation.

- Develop a robust and diverse partner ecosystem across APAC, with established governance and a clear path to sustained growth.

- Be recognized as a strategic leader within the company, defining and executing the long-term partnership vision for the AMER region.
The actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
 
The salary hiring range for this position is $320,000 - $360,000 OTE on a 60 - 40 split.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
 
Play a key role by joining an exceptionally high-functioning Customer Success team at Sitetracker, where you'll directly impact customer retention and growth by demonstrating tangible value and ROI. You will own and drive strategic change across a diverse client portfolio, shaping the future success of our customers in the US region while experiencing constant growth challenges and opportunities.
 
What You'll Do
 
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will use your ability to conduct business discussions, negotiations, and strategic conversations and be instrumental in driving customer value across the dynamic US region, partnering with a diverse portfolio of Enterprise and Regional accounts. You will own the strategic relationship, meticulously creating, maintaining, and executing success and account plans that clearly articulate ROI and Sitetracker’s business value. This includes skillfully navigating complex customer organizations to build deep rapport and trust with senior leadership, understanding their mission-critical milestones and strategic objectives. 
 
You will proactively assess and diagnose customer challenges, developing comprehensive mitigation plans to prevent churn and elevate the overall customer experience through seamless cross-functional collaboration. Furthermore, you will continuously reinforce and improve Customer Success processes, always seeking to go above and beyond in every interaction, both externally with clients and internally with our teams. You will serve as a vital conduit, ensuring our customers’ voices are heard and their evolving needs are met with innovative solutions.
 
The Skills You'll Have
Core Customer Success Manager skills:
Manage a diverse portfolio of enterprise accounts, applying high-touch engagement models that drive strong relationships and help customers realize measurable value from the platform.
Create and execute impactful account and success plans, demonstrating a strong customer-first mindset and ensuring customers achieve clear business value from their investment.
Collaborate with Renewals and Sales counterparts to share customer health insights and influence positive renewal outcomes for six- and seven-figure contracts.
Develop a deep understanding of your book of business to anticipate risks, remove blockers, and proactively guide customers toward successful outcomes.
Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, positioning yourself as a strategic advisor and strong advocate for your customers internally.
 
Improving customer experience and satisfaction, including stakeholder management:
Fostered deep customer relationships through working in a 'high-touch' engagement model
Engages effectively at all levels of a business, from daily interactions with mid-management to monthly/quarterly executive cadences.
Expertise in creating and delivering compelling content tailored for executive audiences, articulating complex value propositions.
Identifies quick wins across your portfolio to rapidly improve user adoption and client satisfaction.
Quickly builds and establishes strong, trusted relationships with Business Sponsors and Economic Buyers.
 
Demonstrating 'Business Value Realisation' (BVR), and contract value:
Ability to identify, demonstrate, and achieve quantifiable business value for your customer(s), aligning with their strategic objectives.
Clearly articulate how you identified value, how it aligned to a customer's overall business objectives, and how it was delivered and measured.
Creates jointly-owned success plans with customers and validates business value with customer executives.
Builds out Success Stories and collaborates with Marketing to publish these with clients, showcasing impact.
Generates public endorsements from clients, serving as powerful advocates for Sitetracker's solutions.
 
Technical Aptitude:
Has previously worked in or with technically focused positions, such as pre-sales, solutions/sales engineering, or implementations.
Ability to demonstrate, configure, or customize prior tools and platforms to meet specific business needs.
Proficient in using modern office suites like Google Docs, PowerPoint, Excel, and various reporting capabilities for day-to-day tasks.
Ability to clearly articulate complex technical problems and devise custom technical solutions that drive tangible customer outcomes.

Within 90 Days, You'll:
- Successfully create and initiate success & account plans for your assigned portfolio of US accounts, aligning with customer and Sitetracker objectives.

- Begin to deeply engage with senior customer leadership across your region, building initial rapport and understanding their critical business drivers and strategic vision.

- Proactively assess and diagnose initial customer issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams to formulate and implement actionable mitigation plans.
Within 180 Days, You'll:
- Consistently execute and refine your success & account plans, actively demonstrating tangible ROI and business value to customers through clear metrics and outcomes.

- Expertly navigate complex customer organizations, turning detractors into champions and driving internal cross-functional improvements that enhance the customer experience.

- Proactively identify and champion opportunities for customer experience enhancement, adoption, and retention, becoming a vocal advocate for customer needs within Sitetracker.
Within 365 Days, You'll:
- Consistently drive retention and expansion across your entire US portfolio, significantly contributing to Sitetracker's growth through strong renewals and increased platform utilization.

- Solidify your position as a trusted advisor for senior customer leadership, influencing their long-term strategy and ensuring Sitetracker is an indispensable partner.

- Shape and optimize Customer Success practices within the US region, contributing directly to Sitetracker's global CS operational excellence and market leadership.
